verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר רָאשֵׁ֣י הַמַּטּ֔וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃ צִוָּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’el- way·ḏab·bêr rā·šê ham·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh
verses.literal: Then Moses . . . said to the heads of the tribes . . . of Israel . . . This . . . is what the LORD has commanded

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אִישׁ֩ יִדֹּ֨ר נֶ֜דֶר לַֽיהוָ֗ה אֽוֹ־ הִשָּׁ֤בַע שְׁבֻעָה֙ לֶאְסֹ֤ר נַפְשׁ֔וֹ עַל־ אִסָּר֙ לֹ֥א יַחֵ֖ל דְּבָר֑וֹ יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃ כְּכָל־ הַיֹּצֵ֥א מִפִּ֖יו
verses.transliteration: kî- ’îš yid·dōr ne·ḏer Yah·weh ’ōw- hiš·šā·ḇa‘ šə·ḇu·‘āh le’·sōr nap̄·šōw ‘al- ’is·sār lō ya·ḥêl də·ḇā·rōw ya·‘ă·śeh kə·ḵāl- hay·yō·ṣê mip·pîw
verses.literal: If a man makes a vow to the LORD or swears an oath to obligate himself - by a pledge he must not break his word he must do everything he has promised . . .

verses.original: כִּֽי־ וְאִשָּׁ֕ה אָבִ֖יהָ בְּבֵ֥ית בִּנְעֻרֶֽיהָ׃ תִדֹּ֥ר נֶ֖דֶר לַיהוָ֑ה וְאָסְרָ֥ה אִסָּ֛ר
verses.transliteration: kî- wə·’iš·šāh ’ā·ḇî·hā bə·ḇêṯ bin·‘u·re·hā ṯid·dōr ne·ḏer Yah·weh wə·’ā·sə·rāh ’is·sār
verses.literal: And if a woman in her father’s house during her youth makes a vow to the LORD or obligates herself by a pledge

verses.original: אָבִ֜יהָ אֶת־ וְשָׁמַ֨ע נִדְרָ֗הּ וֶֽאֱסָרָהּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽסְרָ֣ה נַפְשָׁ֔הּ עַל־ אָבִ֑יהָ וְהֶחֱרִ֥ישׁ לָ֖הּ כָּל־ נְדָרֶ֔יהָ וְכָל־ אִסָּ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ אָסְרָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֖הּ יָקֽוּם׃ עַל־ וְקָ֙מוּ֙
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇî·hā ’eṯ- wə·šā·ma‘ niḏ·rāh we·’ĕ·sā·rāh ’ă·šer ’ā·sə·rāh nap̄·šāh ‘al- ’ā·ḇî·hā wə·he·ḥĕ·rîš lāh kāl- nə·ḏā·re·hā wə·ḵāl ’is·sār ’ă·šer- ’ā·sə·rāh nap̄·šāh yā·qūm ‘al- wə·qā·mū
verses.literal: and her father - hears about her vow or pledge - - - - [but] says nothing to her then all the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself . . . . . . shall stand

verses.original: וְאִם־ אָבִ֣יהָ אֹתָהּ֮ הֵנִ֨יא בְּי֣וֹם שָׁמְעוֹ֒ כָּל־ לֹ֣א נְדָרֶ֗יהָ וֶֽאֱסָרֶ֛יהָ אֲשֶׁר־ אָסְרָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֖הּ עַל־ יָק֑וּם וַֽיהוָה֙ יִֽסְלַח־ לָ֔הּ כִּי־ אָבִ֖יהָ אֹתָֽהּ׃ הֵנִ֥יא
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ā·ḇî·hā ’ō·ṯāh hê·nî bə·yō·wm šā·mə·‘ōw kāl- lō nə·ḏā·re·hā we·’ĕ·sā·re·hā ’ă·šer- ’ā·sə·rāh nap̄·šāh ‘al- yā·qūm Yah·weh yis·laḥ- lāh kî- ’ā·ḇî·hā ’ō·ṯāh hê·nî
verses.literal: But if her father - prohibits her on the day he hears about it then none of the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself - shall stand The LORD will absolve her because her father - has prohibited her

verses.original: וְאִם־ הָי֤וֹ תִֽהְיֶה֙ לְאִ֔ישׁ וּנְדָרֶ֖יהָ עָלֶ֑יהָ א֚וֹ מִבְטָ֣א שְׂפָתֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַפְשָֽׁהּ׃ אָסְרָ֖ה עַל־
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- hā·yōw ṯih·yeh lə·’îš ū·nə·ḏā·re·hā ‘ā·le·hā ’ōw miḇ·ṭā śə·p̄ā·ṯe·hā ’ă·šer nap̄·šāh ’ā·sə·rāh ‘al-
verses.literal: If a woman marries . . . . . . while under a vow . . . or rash promise . . . by which she has bound herself

verses.original: אִישָׁ֛הּ וְשָׁמַ֥ע וְהֶחֱרִ֣ישׁ לָ֑הּ בְּי֥וֹם שָׁמְע֖וֹ נְדָרֶ֗יהָ וְקָ֣מוּ וֶֽאֱסָרֶ֛הָ אֲשֶׁר־ נַפְשָׁ֖הּ אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־ יָקֻֽמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·šāh wə·šā·ma‘ wə·he·ḥĕ·rîš lāh bə·yō·wm šā·mə·‘ōw nə·ḏā·re·hā wə·qā·mū we·’ĕ·sā·re·hā ’ă·šer- nap̄·šāh ’ā·sə·rāh ‘al- yā·qu·mū
verses.literal: and her husband hears of it but says nothing to her on that day - then the vows - or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand

verses.original: וְ֠אִם אִישָׁהּ֮ יָנִ֣יא אוֹתָהּ֒ בְּי֨וֹם שְׁמֹ֣עַ וְהֵפֵ֗ר אֶת־ נִדְרָהּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ וְאֵת֙ מִבְטָ֣א שְׂפָתֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַפְשָׁ֑הּ אָסְרָ֖ה עַל־ וַיהוָ֖ה יִֽסְלַֽח־ לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im ’î·šāh yā·nî ’ō·w·ṯāh bə·yō·wm šə·mō·a‘ wə·hê·p̄êr ’eṯ- niḏ·rāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·le·hā wə·’êṯ miḇ·ṭā śə·p̄ā·ṯe·hā ’ă·šer nap̄·šāh ’ā·sə·rāh ‘al- Yah·weh yis·laḥ- lāh
verses.literal: But if her husband prohibits her when he hears of it he nullifies - the vow that binds her - or the rash promise . . . - she has made . . . and the LORD will absolve her

verses.original: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ וְנֵ֥דֶר אַלְמָנָ֖ה וּגְרוּשָׁ֑ה אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־ נַפְשָׁ֖הּ יָק֥וּם עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.literal: Every - vow a widow or divorced woman pledges to fulfill . . . . . . is binding on her

verses.original: וְאִם־ אִישָׁ֖הּ בֵּ֥ית נָדָ֑רָה אֽוֹ־ נַפְשָׁ֖הּ עַל־ אָסְרָ֥ה אִסָּ֛ר בִּשְׁבֻעָֽה׃
verses.literal: If a woman in her husband’s house has made a vow or put herself under an obligation . . . with an oath

verses.original: אִישָׁהּ֙ וְשָׁמַ֤ע וְהֶחֱרִ֣שׁ לָ֔הּ לֹ֥א הֵנִ֖יא אֹתָ֑הּ כָּל־ נְדָרֶ֔יהָ וְקָ֙מוּ֙ וְכָל־ אִסָּ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ אָסְרָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֖הּ עַל־ יָקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·šāh wə·šā·ma‘ wə·he·ḥĕ·riš lāh lō hê·nî ’ō·ṯāh kāl- nə·ḏā·re·hā wə·qā·mū wə·ḵāl ’is·sār ’ă·šer- ’ā·sə·rāh nap̄·šāh ‘al- yā·qūm
verses.literal: and her husband hears of it but says nothing to her and does not prohibit her - then all the vows - or pledges by which she has bound herself . . . shall stand

verses.original: וְאִם־ אִישָׁהּ֮ הָפֵר֩ בְּי֣וֹם שָׁמְעוֹ֒ כָּל־ לֹ֣א מוֹצָ֨א שְׂפָתֶ֧יהָ לִנְדָרֶ֛יהָ נַפְשָׁ֖הּ וּלְאִסַּ֥ר יָק֑וּם אִישָׁ֣הּ הֲפֵרָ֔ם יָפֵ֨ר אֹתָ֥ם׀ וַיהוָ֖ה יִֽסְלַֽח־ לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’î·šāh hā·p̄êr bə·yō·wm šā·mə·‘ōw kāl- lō mō·w·ṣā śə·p̄ā·ṯe·hā lin·ḏā·re·hā nap̄·šāh ū·lə·’is·sar yā·qūm ’î·šāh hă·p̄ê·rām yā·p̄êr ’ō·ṯām Yah·weh yis·laḥ- lāh
verses.literal: But if her husband nullifies them on the day he hears of them then nothing . . . that came from her lips whether her vows - or pledges shall stand Her husband . . . has nullified them - and the LORD will absolve her

verses.original: אִישָׁ֥הּ יְקִימֶ֖נּוּ וְאִישָׁ֥הּ יְפֵרֶֽנּוּ׃ כָּל־ נֵ֛דֶר וְכָל־ שְׁבֻעַ֥ת אִסָּ֖ר לְעַנֹּ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: ’î·šāh yə·qî·men·nū wə·’î·šāh yə·p̄ê·ren·nū kāl- nê·ḏer wə·ḵāl šə·ḇu·‘aṯ ’is·sār lə·‘an·nōṯ nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Her husband may confirm . . . or nullify any vow or any sworn pledge to deny herself

verses.original: וְאִם־ אִישָׁהּ֮ הַחֲרֵשׁ֩ יַחֲרִ֨ישׁ לָ֥הּ מִיּ֣וֹם אֶל־ יוֹם֒ וְהֵקִים֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ נְדָרֶ֔יהָ א֥וֹ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֱסָרֶ֖יהָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֑יהָ הֵקִ֣ים אֹתָ֔ם כִּי־ הֶחֱרִ֥שׁ לָ֖הּ בְּי֥וֹם שָׁמְעֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’î·šāh ha·ḥă·rêš ya·ḥă·rîš lāh mî·yō·wm ’el- yō·wm wə·hê·qîm ’eṯ- kāl- nə·ḏā·re·hā ’ōw ’eṯ- kāl- ’ĕ·sā·re·hā ’ă·šer ‘ā·le·hā hê·qîm ’ō·ṯām kî- he·ḥĕ·riš lāh bə·yō·wm šā·mə·‘ōw
verses.literal: But if her husband says nothing . . . to her from day to day then he confirms - all the vows and - - pledges that bind her He has confirmed them because he said nothing to her on the day he heard about them

verses.original: וְאִם־ הָפֵ֥ר יָפֵ֛ר אֹתָ֖ם אַחֲרֵ֣י שָׁמְע֑וֹ וְנָשָׂ֖א אֶת־ עֲוֺנָֽהּ׃
verses.literal: But if he nullifies . . . them after he hears of them then he will bear her iniquity

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ צִוָּ֤ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ לְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ בֵּֽין־ אָ֣ב לְבִתּ֔וֹ בִּנְעֻרֶ֖יהָ אָבִֽיהָ׃פ בֵּ֥ית
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ha·ḥuq·qîm ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh bên ’îš lə·’iš·tōw bên- ’āḇ lə·ḇit·tōw bin·‘u·re·hā ’ā·ḇî·hā bêṯ
verses.literal: These are the statutes that the LORD - commanded Moses concerning the relationship between a man and his wife and between a father and a young daughter . . . still in his home
